title: CoVA-SFT: A Large-Scale Dataset for Chain of Visual Abstractions
abstract: arXiv:2608.28958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has dramatically improved large language models (LLMs) by allowing them to decompose problems into intermediate steps. While CoT is widely effective for linguistic tasks, text-only CoT forces models to serialize visual problems into awkward prose. Although architectural solutions exist to process visual inputs, the community lacks a massive, multi-step, self-corrected dataset to teach models how to build and maintain internal visual workspaces when solving purely textual reasoning problems. To address this limitation, we introduce CoVA-SFT, a highly structured corpus of 51.9K samples containing over 222K multimodal reasoning steps across 5 distinct layout families and 17 complex tasks, and CoVA-Bench, a companion benchmark of 1,700 held-out test samples spanning the same tasks for reproducible evaluation. translated_title: CoVA-SFT：一个面向视觉抽象链的大规模数据集
translated_abstract: 思维链推理通过允许大语言模型（LLM）将问题分解为中间步骤，显著提升了其性能。虽然CoT在语言类任务中被广泛证明有效，但纯文本的CoT迫使模型将视觉问题序列化为笨拙的文字描述。尽管已有处理视觉输入的架构解决方案，但社区仍缺乏一个大规模、多步骤、自我纠错的数据集，用于教导模型在解决纯文本推理问题时如何构建和维护内部视觉工作空间。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了CoVA-SFT，这是一个高度结构化的语料库，包含51.9K个样本、超过222K个多模态推理步骤，涵盖5种不同的布局家族和17个复杂任务；同时我们还推出了配套基准CoVA-Bench，包含1,700个保留测试样本，覆盖相同任务，用于可复现的评估。通过提供显式的推理依据表述、代理式渲染和验证循环，CoVA-SFT为模型……
tldr: 该论文提出了CoVA-SFT数据集（含51.9K样本、超过222K多模态推理步骤，覆盖5种布局家族和17个任务）及配套基准CoVA-Bench，用于教导模型在纯文本推理中构建和维护内部视觉工作空间。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CoVA-SFT, a large-scale structured dataset of 51.9K samples with over 222K multimodal reasoning steps across 5 layout families and 17 tasks, along with the CoVA-Bench benchmark, to teach models how to build and maintain internal visual workspaces when solving purely textual reasoning problems.
